caption: The drawing depicts a wooden double-door with two panels, each door containing three rectangular sections. The top sections are arched, the middle sections are rectangular with a small central square window or opening painted in black, and the bottom sections are rectangular as well. The wood is illustrated in a faded greenish-brown color, with visible grain, texture, and dark marks that suggest wear and aging. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and the door is centered within the composition, taking up most of the image area. There are no objects, decorations, or features other than the wooden door itself and some minimal shading around its edges. In the lower right corner, there is a small handwritten text that appears to be a signature and a date.
title: Doors to Confessional
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
